raw_text: URGENT — Students Against Discrimination (Facebook Group Post). We call on all students across Bangladesh to join the nationwide march on July 15. The government's quota system reserves 56% of civil service jobs for privileged categories while millions of educated youth remain unemployed. This is not a protest against any community — this is a fight for merit-based recruitment. Share this post widely. Meeting points for Dhaka: Shahbag intersection at 10 AM, Dhaka University campus at 9 AM. Stay peaceful, stay united. #QuotaReform #StudentsAgainstDiscrimination
